verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, such as bulk export of flows, tables or run history in an open format. Open-source licensing, self-hosting and a REST API with an OpenAPI spec are adjacent openness traits or developer building blocks, not a documented export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
